text:
Maya: Quick pulse — post-launch dashboard is noisy, conversion looks down 18% this morning :eyes:. Can marketing ops give a quick read?
Sam: Seeing same — funnel drop between landing -> signup. Raw sessions steady. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
Priya: Any change to the UTM/redirect rules during deploy? last change was the PR that flipped 302->307.
Sam: Nope, no redirects changed. I grabbed a quick cohort: `SELECT utm_source, count(*) FROM events WHERE date >= '2026-03-15' GROUP BY 1;` results look consistent.
report-bot: Automated report: 03/20 09:00 UTC — Sessions: +2% vs yesterday, Signups: -18%, Webinar regs: +12%. Top landing pages: /launch, /pricing. Attribution window: 7d default.
Julian: Webinar registrations up, but conversion to paid trial down. Maybe lower intent traffic coming via content partners?
Kira: Flag — some landing links had missing utm_medium (we found ~3.2k hits with utm_source=partner but utm_medium=null). Could skew channel attribution.
Maya: OK — if medium missing, session attributed to direct which hides partner performance. Priya, can you run an events check for utm_medium null by source + landing page?
Priya: On it. Running quick query, will post top 5 affected sources in 10m.
Sam: Also worth checking if the experiment at /pricing changed the CTA text on the 18th. That could affect signup conversion.
Julian: Agreed. I'll cross-check the feature flags. If CTA copy changed -> different funnel behavior.
Maya: If we confirm medium missing for partner, we should ask engineering to add fallback param or fix redirect template. Can we triage priority? 
Sam: I can open a ticket and tag eng-infra; severity = P2. 
report-bot: Ticket created: #INC-4182 — investigate UTM loss on partner landing redirects. Assigned: eng-infra.
Kira: Quick patch idea: add javascript fallback to set utm_medium=partner when source=partner. Low risk but messy. Prefer redirect fix.
Priya: Query results: top sources with utm_medium null -> partnerA (1.4k), partnerB (850), newsletter (620), unknown (350), partnerC (210).
Maya: Thanks. Let's run an adjusted attribution model excluding sessions with utm_medium null to see signal. Sam, Priya, can one of you produce a short dashboard tile with both raw and cleaned metrics before EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: Yep, I'll add a tile and pin to the weekly report. 
Julian: I'll standby on feature flag — will revert CTA on canary if necessary.
Maya: Cool. 15:00 sync? Quick 15min to confirm actions. If anything high-risk pops up ping #release-war-room. :bell:
Sam: Added to calendar 15:00. 
report-bot: Summary saved to /dashboards/weekly-launch/notes — link: https://app.redwood/dashboards/weekly-launch/notes
Kira: Thanks — will also add a small note for the partners team. :memo:
Maya: Great work team. We'll reconvene at 15:00.
